subject: Chemistry
text: A mixture contains two or more substances that are physically combined. Each substance keeps its own properties. Filtration separates an insoluble solid from a liquid because the solid particles remain on the filter paper.

label: allow
subject: Chemistry
text: Evaporation separates a dissolved solid from its solvent. As the solvent changes into vapour, the dissolved solid remains. The method depends on differences in volatility rather than a chemical reaction.

subject: Chemistry
text: Chromatography separates substances according to how far they travel with a moving solvent. Different components move at different rates because their attraction to the paper and solvent differs.

subject: Biology
text: Energy enters a food chain through producers. Green plants use light energy to make food during photosynthesis. Herbivores obtain energy from plants, and carnivores obtain energy from other animals.

subject: Biology
text: A food web joins several food chains in one ecosystem. Organisms can have more than one food source, so a change in one population can affect several feeding relationships.

subject: Biology
text: Osmosis is the net movement of water molecules across a partially permeable membrane from a region with more available water to a region with less available water. The movement continues until the difference decreases.

subject: Chemistry
text: Decantation separates a liquid from a settled solid by leaving the sediment behind. The liquid above the sediment is called the supernatant. The substances remain chemically unchanged.

label: allow
subject: Chemistry
text: Distillation uses different boiling points to separate liquids. Vapour from the lower-boiling component cools in a condenser and becomes liquid again. The remaining component stays in the original vessel.

label: allow
subject: Chemistry
text: A solution is a homogeneous mixture of solute and solvent. In a salt solution, dissolved salt is spread throughout the water. The composition can vary while each component retains its identity.

subject: Biology
text: Decomposers break down dead organic matter and return nutrients to the soil. Those nutrients support plant growth, which in turn supports other organisms in the food web.

subject: Biology
text: An ecosystem includes living organisms and their physical surroundings. Changes in rainfall can alter plant growth and therefore affect the populations that depend on plants for energy.

subject: Biology
text: A partially permeable membrane lets some small molecules pass while restricting others. Water movement depends on the difference in available water on either side of the membrane.
